plugins.prepareCmd: dotnet build --configuration Release -p:Version=${nextRelease.version} && python scripts/pack-release-packages.py ./nupkgs ${nextRelease.version} && python scripts/validate-nuget-packages.py ./nupkgs
plugins.publishCmd: HEXALITH_REQUIRE_CONTAINER_PUBLISHER=true bash scripts/validate-release-secrets.sh && dotnet nuget push ./nupkgs/*.nupkg --source https://api.nuget.org/v3/index.json --api-key "$NUGET_API_KEY" --skip-duplicate && ./.hexalith/release/publish-containers.sh ${nextRelease.version}
